name: Impulse
tagline: A trust-first hiring platform where verified human candidates and recruiters interact with agent help.

awards: World U: Build for the future of the internet with World

problem: Students applying for internships send many applications and get little signal back.
solution: Applicant and recruiter portals with job postings, application history, messaging and agent interactions, with World ID to verify that candidates are real.
demo_moment: Team-described: an applicant applies and a recruiter replies in the verified pipeline.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “World U: Build for the future of the internet with World” among 307 submissions.
Shaped by interviews with students and recruiters before coding.

lessons: Interview both sides first; trust problems show up on both.
